description: The character twist of the decoded (s,i) = (3,4) bordered Goethals-Seidel record at order 1916.  This is the non-house-Gram witness of note/NOTE-B.md S1.2 and the diagonal conjugation of S3.3, in one file: for every character psibar of Gbar = G/K the substitution below carries the record to another instance of the master theorem whose Gram is psibar . M -- not the house form when psibar is nontrivial -- and every one of those instances is S H S for a diagonal S.  Nothing here is a free parameter: psibar ranges over the character group of Gbar, which the record's own coset_divisors determine, and certs/09-1916-conjugation/run.py re-derives all of it.

base.group_note: Z2 x Z2 x Z119 = Z2 x Z2 x Z7 x Z17

character.definition: psi = psibar . kappa, where kappa: G -> Gbar is the coset map of coset_divisors (so ker kappa = K, of index i = 4) and psibar is a character of Gbar.  Gbar = Z2 x Z2 is elementary abelian, so every psibar takes values in {+1,-1}; hence psi^2 = 1 and psi|_K = 1 for all four.
character.indexing: coset index c is mixed-radix over coset_divisors, exactly the indexing kappa uses; Gbar element c is Gbar_elements[c]
character.psibar_rule: chars[t][c] = product over coordinates j of (-1)^(t_j * c_j)
character.psibar_note: the character reading the FIRST coordinate of Gbar -- the one the upstream witness used (skeptic/attack5_nonhouse_M.py, experiments/inequiv/equiv_witness.py)
character.psi_of_rho_note: r_shift = [0,0,0], so rho is the identity of G and kappa(rho) = 0; hence psi(rho) = psibar(0) = +1 for EVERY character, and NOTE-B S1.4's proposition applies to all of them

substitution.row_table: P'[r][c] = psibar(c mod i) * P[r][c]   (P' = P Dbar)
substitution.col_table: Q'[k][r] = psibar(k mod i) * Q[k][r]   (Q' = Dbar Q), where Q[i*I + c][r] = col_table[r][i*I + c]
substitution.source: the same substitution as the lab's skeptic/attack5_nonhouse_M.py and experiments/inequiv/equiv_witness.py

conjugation.S_rule: sgn[j] = +1 for j < 4s; sgn[4s + I*n + g] = psibar(kappa(g)) for I in 0..3 and g in 0..n-1

pinned.house_source: experiments/bordered_gs_theorem/theorem_check_report.json upstream; also cert 01 in this repository
pinned.twisted_source: the upstream skeptic lane's attack 5 (LANE-D-SKEPTIC-REPORT.md) and experiments/inequiv/build_pairs.py
